scope: Repository-only preparation for a later Knowledge migration. It is not a migration, cutover, USI activation, runtime wiring, provider action, network action, private-data read, deletion, deployment or live Go.

target.outcome: Produce deterministic, owner-scoped, payload-free fixture evidence that a later separately authorized migration can compare without treating an existing Native USI adapter or historical H1R-05 route as Harbour authority.
forbidden: writes to an existing knowledge database

representation.snapshot: KnowledgeMigrationSnapshot is one exact frozen dataclass. Its digest frames schema_id=odysseus.harbour.knowledge_migration_snapshot.v1, owner_ref_digest, captured_head_boundary and an ordered tuple of at most 10,000 frozen HeadMetadata values. Every record has opaque knowledge_id/revision_id digests, revision number, head generation, lifecycle state, knowledge_kind, classification/retention/provenance/source-reference digests and record digest. Ordering is by opaque knowledge_id then revision; duplicates, oversize/non-exact fields or digest disagreement reject. No payload, raw owner, path, URL, principal or mutable alias appears.
representation.capture: An additive HarbourKnowledgeStore method accepts the existing exact TrustedPrincipal plus exact built-in expected owner boundary or explicit no-freshness mode. It authenticates/binds owner before an owned deferred read transaction, runs bounded owner-filtered metadata-only queries, copies primitive rows once and reliably rolls back/closes. It changes no constructor/admission/replay/lifecycle/schema or mutating pragma. Empty is valid; oversize, incomplete, corrupt, stale expected boundary or SQLite failure returns detached bounded error. Capture is consistent at its SQLite boundary only; no-freshness mode makes no fresh-now promise.
representation.projection: After accepted frozen Snapshot A, a new Harbour-only pure converter accepts only that exact representation and emits fixed harbour-knowledge/v1 metadata-reference records. It creates no Native authority binding/capability/existing Native locator and does not instantiate, register or modify KnowledgeSourceAdapter.
representation.comparison: After accepted frozen Snapshot A, only the isolated fixture API in src/harbour_snapshot_comparison.py accepts exact source, target and post snapshots and emits a bounded content-free report with role-labelled source_to_target and target_to_post missing, extra and changed opaque ids. Owner/schema mismatch rejects. It must not import, call, return or reference the legacy migration module, MigrationProof, MigrationProofStatus, GO/status/evidence objects or concepts; it cannot trigger migration, infer policy or mutate either store. Digest equality is fixture metadata comparison only, establishes no live state or completion, and supplies no migration or activation authorization.

invariants: Owner authentication and exact owner binding precede every database observation.
A snapshot is one consistent read boundary; its digest binds its ordered primitive records and no payload.

Apart from the required exact TrustedPrincipal authentication object, all snapshot/projection/comparison data is exact built-in data copied before comparison, hashing, serialization or SQLite access; subclasses, aliases, iterators and hooks fail closed.
The Harbour snapshot/projection path is distinct from NativeKnowledgeStore authority and does not widen any USI capability.
Comparison is deterministic, reports missing/extra/changed metadata only, and never supplies a migration or activation authorization.
No package may claim H1R-05 completion; only the later fixture integration may establish readiness for a separately reviewed migration packet.

depends_on: H1R-05A accepted and frozen as a read-only pin
H1R-05A accepted and frozen as a read-only pin
isolated snapshot comparison architecture and exact accepted source/test pins read-only
acceptance: only the isolated fixture API performs deterministic role-labelled source/target/post comparison
no legacy module, MigrationProof, GO/status/evidence reference, mutation, migration, activation or completion claim

integration: A, B and C may be authored only one critical writer at a time. A is integrated and frozen first; B and C then consume its exact read-only candidate pin serially. No worker reads a concurrently changing writer path as authority.
stop_rules: Any schema/version/migration/cutover requirement invalidates this draft.
Any request to use NativeKnowledgeStore as Harbour authority invalidates this draft.
Any private-data, network, provider, deployment or deletion requirement is a separate user gate.
